assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries.
The patient has a concern for intermittent arrhythmia as the underlying etiology of these collapse events.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during symptomatic periods.
The service is mobile cardiac telemetry with CPT 93229.
SilverBridge Advantage requires precertification for this non-emergency diagnostic monitoring service.
The missing authorization is the basis for the CO-197 denial.
The service addresses the documented clinical indication of recurrent syncope in the setting of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries.
